div.div:
v1 build status (2026-10): printed; centre section, wing panels, nose fitted.
Open: V-tail, tilt-motor mounts, CG + ±30° throws (B00), camera mount, bay layout.
6 servos per manual: 2 tilt + 2 aileron + 2 ruddervator (verify allocation in B14).
